name: CartLine
signature: interface CartLine { productId: string; quantity: number; }

name: Cart
signature: interface Cart { id: string; lines: CartLine[]; currency: Currency; }

name: emptyCart
signature: function emptyCart(id: string, currency: Currency): Cart { return { id, lines: [], currency }; }

name: applyPromoToCart
signature: function applyPromoToCart( cart: Cart, code: PromoCode, ): DiscountResult { const subtotal = cart.lines.reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.quantity, 0); return { amount: applyPromo(code, subtotal), applied: code }; }
